title: PlayerEdit
description: PlayerEdit allows you to edit your username, skin, and more.
body:
# PlayerEdit

A lightweight, modern Paper/Purpur plugin that lets server owners customize how their server appears — without touching server.properties or modifying player data.

PlayerEdit provides:

- **Fake Max Players** (server list only)
- **Player Limit Bypass** (per‑player)
- **Fake Display Name** (chat + tablist)

Compatible with **Paper / Purpur 1.20 – 1.21+**  

---

## ✨ Features

### ✔ Fake Max Players  
Modify the max player count shown in the server list without changing `server.properties`.

### ✔ Player Limit Bypass  
Allow specific players to join even when the server is full.

### ✔ Fake Display Name  
Change a player’s display name and tablist name instantly.

---

## 📦 Commands

| Command | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `/playeredit limit <number>` | Set fake max players |
| `/playeredit bypass <player> <true/false>` | Toggle limit bypass |
| `/playeredit fake <player> <name>` | Set fake display + tablist name |
| `/playeredit skin` | Disabled (API‑only mode) |
| `/playeredit uuid` | Disabled (API‑only mode) |

---

## 🔐 Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|-----------|-------------|---------|
| `playeredit.use` | Use `/playeredit` | OP |
| `playeredit.edit` | Edit limits & identities | OP |
| `playeredit.bypass` | Join when server is full | OP |

---

## 🛠 Installation

1. Download the latest `.jar` 
2. Drop it into your `plugins/` folder  
3. Start your server
4. Edit `config.yml` if needed  
5. Enjoy!

---

## 📁 Configuration

```yaml
fake-max-players: 20
